query: SELECT currency AS "currency!",SUM(amount_micros)::text AS "amount!" FROM analytics_normalized_facts r WHERE owner_id=$1 AND fact_kind='request' AND NOT deleted AND occurred_at>=$2 AND occurred_at<$3 AND currency IS NOT NULL AND ($4::text IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics_normalized_facts a WHERE a.owner_id=r.owner_id AND a.fact_kind='resource_association' AND NOT a.deleted AND a.resource_id=$4 AND a.request_source=r.source AND a.request_id=r.fact_id)) GROUP BY currency
